title: Offline and reconnect resilience
summary: When connectivity is lost, preserve usable local state, explain what is unavailable, and make sync or retry behavior explicit.
problem: Network loss often destroys work or makes all content appear broken even when cached or local functionality could continue.
use_when: The product performs network-dependent work or sync
Users may spend meaningful time composing or editing before a request
avoid_when: The product genuinely cannot perform any useful action without connectivity and no local state exists
rationale: Offline is a state, not necessarily a fatal error.
Preserving unsynced work prevents data loss.

use_if: The product performs network-dependent work or sync
Users may spend meaningful time composing or editing before a request
prefer_alternatives_if: A short transient request failure can be retried transparently without misleading the user

requirements: Announce connectivity or sync status changes without repeatedly stealing focus.
Do not rely on icon or color alone to indicate unsynced work.
Show when work is unsynced and when it becomes saved.
